name: archimedes
description: AI trading strategies that fuse user intent with market data, academic research, and statistical rigor to help you win more than you lose.  🏆 Selected as a Standout Project in the Agora Agents Hackathon!

paragraphs: Portfolio strategy, under scrutiny. Archimedes is an agentic strategy generation and validation system, grounded in research and statistical rigor. You describe what you want from a portfolio in plain English; it proposes strategies drawn from a corpus of arXiv quantitative-finance preprints, and then the part that makes it different — the honest validation layer — spends its effort trying to reject every one of them: a deflated Sharpe ratio, a probability of backtest overfitting, a walk-forward out-of-sample pass, and a static look-ahead audit, with the measured verdict recorded whichever…
